evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, _timer_schedule_seconds still computes the timer completion bound as max(calendar/repeat intervals) + AccuracySec and never reads RandomizedDelaySec. systemd adds RandomizedDelaySec to a timer's next elapse, so a template declaring it can pass the computed bound while actual activation is later. The supplied current code shows no rejection or accounting for that directive, making this an ordinary bound-calculation defect rather than a new requirement.
